answer: An agent economy defeats fake identities with a staking bond: every new identity locks a small refundable stake for one epoch, returned after verified work — so an honest agent pays nothing but patience. An attacker minting a thousand fakes must lock a thousand stakes at once, capital that peers can slash for coordinated fraud. Like a mesa over flatlands, the bond makes real agents stand tall; each fake is only a whisper in the crowd, and honest work leaves a crystal-clear reputation trail no fake can afford to forge.
